system.description:
• Rangers who walk at the front of the march with axe, spear and shield, trading stealth for strength.
  • Vanguard's Build: Strength replaces Dexterity as a key attribute, and your 15th-level bonus is +1 Strength instead. Advantage on Strength checks to climb, swim and force obstacles in the wild.
  • Axe and Shield: Advantage on your first attack roll each round with a hand axe, battle axe or spear while you carry a shield.
